استنهضت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْهَضْتُ (istanhaḍtu) /is.tan.hadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# اِسْتَنْهَضْتَ (istanhaḍta) /is.tan.hadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# اِسْتَنْهَضْتِ (istanhaḍti) /is.tan.hadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْهَضَ (istanhaḍa)
# اِسْتَنْهَضَتْ (istanhaḍat) /i
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
